task_description: How much did I save by purchasing a season pass instead of daily tickets for California's Great America in San Jose, if I planned to visit once a month in June, July, August, and September during the summer of 2024?

critical_error_analysis.conflict_type_description: Conflicts with visible CONTEXT (environment observations, tool output, system feedback, prior environment-rendered facts)
critical_error_analysis.conflict_type_reason: The agent ignored visible context from prior steps showing the 2025 Gold Pass only includes WinterFest (a winter event) in 2024, not summer 2024 coverage.
critical_error_analysis.wrong_content_quote: 2025 Gold Season Pass = $99 (covers 2024 and 2025 seasons with unlimited visits, free parking, incl. WinterFest).
critical_error_analysis.reference_quote: 2025 Gold Pass: $99 (includes WinterFest in 2024, unlimited visits in 2025)
critical_error_analysis.taxonomy_reason: The agent failed to incorporate the critical limitation that WinterFest coverage does not extend to summer months when interpreting pass benefits.
critical_error_analysis.error_explanation: The agent incorrectly assumed the 2025 Gold Pass covered summer 2024 visits because it mentioned 'WinterFest in 2024', but WinterFest is a December/January event irrelevant to June-September visits. This fundamental misinterpretation of pass coverage made accurate savings calculation impossible, as the agent used invalid pricing assumptions for the requested timeframe.
critical_error_analysis.chain_explanation: Trajectory failed because agent persistently searched for non-existent 2024 pricing while website exclusively displayed 2025 pricing. Q1(i) and (ii) hold: wrong commitment remains active at terminal step and is reflected in final action. Evidence: 'I clicked 'www.cagreatamerica.com'; Screenshot: https://www.cagreatamerica.com/; Viewport: 16% top; OCR: California's Great America; Tickets & Passes | Places to Stay | Rides & Experiences | Park Info | WinterFest; Choose Another Park; WinterFest; Select Nights thru Jan 5; Unlimited visits with 2025 Gold Pass; Hurry! Offer ends Jan 5'

fix_suggestion.hint_sentence: When a pass includes a specific seasonal event (e.g., WinterFest), verify its dates align with the user's requested period before assuming year-round coverage.
fix_suggestion.narrative_summary: The agent began searching for 2024 ticket prices but immediately encountered 2025 passes at step 8 without recognizing the year mismatch, triggering persistent scrolling through irrelevant pages. After 18 wasted steps stuck in a loop, replanning at step 35 compounded the error by misinterpreting the 2025 Gold Pass as covering summer 2024 due to its WinterFest inclusion—a winter event unrelated to the June-September visits. This critical misrepresentation of pass coverage, combined with failure to acknowledge 2024 pricing unavailability, made accurate savings calculation impossible despite 44 total steps, with 77% of steps wasted on unproductive exploration.

alternative_critical_steps.reason: The agent first encountered '2025 Gold Pass' pricing at this step but failed to recognize the year mismatch, initiating the persistent search for non-existent 2024 data.
alternative_critical_steps.hint_sentence: Immediately confirm product years match the user's query when first encountering pricing information to prevent wasted exploration.
